candidate_bundle.literal_feasible_set: one common undirected spanning tree; induced arborescences at EVERY vertex root
candidate_bundle.objective: sum of complete rooted-tree arc costs with independent explicit cost vectors
candidate_bundle.graph: connected simple; sparse gadget graph, at most1+2n+3m edges
candidate_bundle.encoding: dense finite input cost table, NOT a dense or complete graph restriction
candidate_bundle.strong_NP_and_unary: polynomially bounded explicit integer values and threshold
candidate_bundle.B2_audit_consequence: same structural identity for B≥2: p+Bq=(Bm+n)+(1-h)+(B-1)(q-m); choosing B2 gives costs0,1,2 and threshold2m+n
candidate_bundle.positive_shift: add1 to every root/arc entry and N(N-1) to threshold; original gives1,2,n+2, B2 gives1,2,3

rows.classical_restrictions_verified: Connected simple unit-length input graph; tree budget N−1; polynomial-sized replication/threshold, hence strong/unary hardness for its own model.
rows.exact_gap: Published threshold-forced support family has fixed core and variable leaf attachments; literal target cost on this family is separable, unlike the grouping savings in the published objective. A different gadget/feasible-set/objective map would need proof.

rows.classical_restrictions_verified: Publisher metadata/definition only; full proof unavailable. No hardness restriction authenticated.
rows.exact_gap: Retrieve/check full original proofs; pair-path cost identity is not target identity.

rows.classical_restrictions_verified: Simple undirected graph, finite edge transportation costs and pair communication data; all-origin flow model and NP-hard pricing subproblem described.
rows.all_roots_single_arc_objective: no: flow amounts multiply arc costs; pricing also has fixed arc costs
rows.exact_gap: Removing flow charges changes pricing problem to minimum arborescence; no fixed c_r reproducing arbitrary tree-dependent demand amount on every feasible tree demonstrated.

rows.classical_restrictions_verified: Specialized shared Steiner arborescence problem uses a common root, terminal subsets, shared directed network fixed costs and user arc costs. Generic topology model permits arbitrary topology families.
rows.all_roots_single_arc_objective: no: common root/user subsets; network may have2cycles
rows.exact_gap: Superclass containment does not imply hardness of one undirected-tree/all-root subclass. Must preserve identical support and all-root full-tree charges.

rows.classical_restrictions_verified: Common tree model, complete-graph assumption in formulation portion, pair requirements/distance inputs. No new hardness proof in checked sections.
rows.exact_gap: Pair-distance costs do not become support costs by renaming variables; dense graph versus dense cost table must be distinguished.

rows.classical_restrictions_verified: NP-hardness on fixed stars, and fixed binary trees; unweighted ordered-pair satisfaction objective.
rows.same_common_tree: tree is INPUT, orientation is selected
rows.all_roots_single_arc_objective: no: arbitrary one orientation, reachability pair score
rows.exact_gap: On a fixed input tree the literal target has exactly one feasible support and all root orientations are forced; no choice corresponds to MTO orientation variables. Degree/approximation results cannot transfer.

rows.classical_restrictions_verified: Directed and undirected NP/APX hardness proofs; undirected degree bound and cost0/1 with two colors are in checked Theorem3. Other restrictions differ by theorem.
rows.exact_gap: The predecessor edge is a chosen variable. A prescribed c_r(u,v) cannot simply substitute for cost of that edge pair. No explicit gadget/cost correspondence provided.

rows.classical_restrictions_verified: NP-complete RootedRA, even with two distinct input arborescence roots in §2 construction; output root fixed. Color constraints and possible parallel colored arcs.
rows.same_common_tree: no: choose rainbow output from colored input supports
rows.exact_gap: Input root count is not number of target cost vectors; identical-underlying-tree theorem is an existence result. Need simple-graph/all-root cost encoding of color feasibility and full objective.

rows.classical_restrictions_verified: Directed fixed-root color model; complete Minimum Ones and Set Cover constructions with bounded in/out degree and nonnegative integer color-pair costs; revised2013 model is quadratic.
rows.same_common_tree: one rooted directed support, NOT all induced vertex-root supports
rows.exact_gap: Per-arc cost model in §3.1 is only a lower bound on changeover cost. Need exact directed-to-undirected/all-root feasible-set and full-cost mapping; original2011 chronology version not checked.

restriction_transfer_rule: Unestablished transfer does not say the source lacks a named restriction; it says that restriction has not been proved for the literal target by this source construction.
cross_row_conclusion: No checked classical construction implies the entire literal target bundle. This finding is bounded source comparison, not novelty establishment. Constant alphabet B2 is an audit consequence of the same candidate identity, not independent novelty clearance.
